verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a consumer GPU, and event-subscription webhooks are a capability of hosted services and APIs, not of graphics hardware, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the card or its software stack offering registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
